missing.title: That customer is not here any more
missing.text: The account may have been deleted, or the id in the address is not a customer. Open it again from the customers list.

orders.title: Orders
orders.note: An admin reads these. Only the stall moves an order through its states, so there is nothing to change here.

reviews.title: Reviews they wrote
reviews.note: Hiding a review is done from Moderation, where the report that triggered it is visible too.

habits.title: Orders by state
habits.loadedNote: Counted from the {{count}} most recently loaded orders, not the full history.

whatItDoes.title: What deactivating does
whatItDoes.text: They cannot sign in or place a new order, and are signed out everywhere right away. A temporary ban leaves their orders alone; a permanent one also cancels any order still placed or accepted and returns the stock.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.text: They are signed out everywhere right away and cannot sign in or place orders. A temporary ban leaves their orders alone; a permanent one also cancels any order still placed or accepted and returns the stock.
deactivate.reasonRequired: Choose at least one reason or add a note.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.text: They can sign in and place orders again right away.

empty.title: No history yet
empty.text: Every deactivate or reactivate on this account will show up here.
